'''Marlim Azul power station''' (Usina Termelétrica Marlim Azul) is an operating power station of at least 565-megawatts (MW) in Macaé, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
It is also known as Vale Azul I.

==Background==

As of early 2022, the Marlim Azul power station was the most advanced of several recently proposed gas plant projects in the Macaé region.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://energiaeambiente.org.br/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/20211214_notatecnicamacaequalidadedoar.pdf|title=Qualidade do Ar em Macaé (RJ)|date=December 2021|access-date=|website=IEMA|last=|first=|archive-url=|archive-date=|url-status=live}}</ref> Construction of the power station began in 2021 with the arrival of new equipment to the site.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://clickpetroleoegas.com.br/em-macae-a-usina-termeletrica-marlim-azul-inicia-nova-fase-de-construcao-com-a-chegada-de-novos-equipamentos/|title=Em Macaé, a Usina Termelétrica Marlim Azul inicia nova fase de construção com a chegada de novos equipamentos|date=2021-08-18|work=CPG Click Petroleo e Gas|access-date=2021-09-09|language=pt-BR}}</ref>

In April 2023, the Marlim Azul plant was authorized to begin test operations<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.canalenergia.com.br/noticias/53243877/aneel-libera-5655-mw-da-ute-marlim-azul-para-teste|title=Aneel libera 565,5 MW da UTE Marlim Azul para teste|last=|first=|date=April 17, 2023|website=CanalEnergia|language=pt-BR|url-status=live|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref>, and in July 2023 the plant received its operating license from the Rio de Janeiro state environmental authority.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://oeco.org.br/reportagens/novas-termeletricas-acendem-o-sinal-de-alerta-em-macae/|title=Novas termelétricas acendem o sinal de alerta em Macaé - ((o))eco|last=Emanuel Alencar|first=|date=July 17, 2023|work=((o))eco|access-date=|language=}}</ref>

As of July 2023, the plant was reported to be in a pre-operational state<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://oeco.org.br/reportagens/novas-termeletricas-acendem-o-sinal-de-alerta-em-macae/|title=Novas termelétricas acendem o sinal de alerta em Macaé|last=Emanuel Alencar|first=|date=July 17, 2023|work=((o))eco|access-date=|language=}}</ref>, with full commercial operations set to begin between late September and early November 2023.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://fusoesaquisicoes.com/acontece-no-setor/patria-estuda-saida-da-termica-marlim-azul/|title=Pátria estuda saída da térmica Marlim Azul|last=|first=|date=September 12, 2023|website=Fusões & Aquisições|url-status=live|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref> 

Marlim Azul has been touted as Brazil's first power plant to operate full-time using gas from the country's offshore "pre-salt" formation.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://valor.globo.com/empresas/noticia/2023/09/12/patria-estuda-saida-da-termica-marlim-azul.ghtml|title=Pátria estuda saída da térmica Marlim Azul|last=|first=|date=September 12, 2023|website=Valor|url-status=live|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref>
